section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section discusses findings from a study on adolescent girls, indicating that online contexts emphasizing external appearance are negatively associated with intuitive eating. The study found that broader conceptualization of beauty and increased body appreciation are positively associated with intuitive eating, suggesting these factors could be targets for future intervention programs.
